title: ID0422792-DC/Si-D/MY-[MP / ND 170000121] Technical Query
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Assistance Required:  We would like to request the details of charging
session captured from charger backend from 29th April 2025 until 1st May
2025. This request is for us to cross check with the charging session
recorded from the third party OCPP installed in the charger. Some of the
details required are:
* Number of charging session.
* kWh delivered for each session.
* Which nozzle used for each session.
